caption:
The video captures a large bonfire of stacked lumber burning in a snow-covered clearing ringed by dense, snow-dusted pine trees. A rounded rock rests at the fire's left base, a cut stump sits to the right, and a thin yellow pole leans in the background. Bright orange-yellow flames and a pale gray-white smoke column rise from the wood pile. The flat boards lying at the left remain in place, except for a brief plank at the edge.

A person in a gray top, dark trousers and orange hat stands left of the fire, then shifts leftward and exits the frame. Only the fire burns for a moment. Near the middle a gloved hand and a long, light-colored wooden plank appear at the left edge, angled toward the fire base, before both vanish. The flame height and shape flicker throughout, taller plumes giving way to lower ones, while the smoke column shifts and thickens. The rock, stump, yellow pole and tree line hold fixed positions.

The bonfire still burns brightly here.
